title: Aureline M5 retirement-manifest change diff
description: Canonical per-domain manifest-change-diff record minted by the retirement-manifest and manifest-change-diff lane over the frozen M5 retired-state matrix. Turns a change in the retirement manifest of a retiring supported line or stable-facing capability into visible, machine-checkable program truth instead of a silent mutation: it records the diff scope a manifest change sits in — a cutoff-date change (the cutoff date after which the class is retired changed), a replacement-path change (the successor / replacement reference changed), or a disable-or-export-route change (the disable path or export / rollback route changed). Names the diff scope, binds the resolved object identity, the affected manifest-field reference, the previous-versus-current manifest-state reference, and the active diff reason so CLI, docs / help, partner-packet, and support-bundle surfaces can show current-versus-previous retirement state rather than re-reading raw manifests by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's retirement transition by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
